messages:
Marta_CS: GroveCare prep for APAC pilot. They asked for header-based allowlist + ephemeral CIDR entry and a burst profile for 36h. Renewal flagged as medium risk.
Priet (GroveCare): Launch window 2026-04-20 09:00 SGT. We'll send header X-GC-Env: pilot and a transient NAT IP 198.51.101.55/32. Request burst to 220 qps for 36h with manual throttle controls. Need logs 21d masked for PHI.
Ishaan_SE: We can set header-match + one-off CIDR on apac-proxy. Recommend soft_limit 220, duration 36h, auto-revoke with 1h buffer. I'll prepare a perf checklist and cost snapshot for renewal.
Li_NetOps: Staging ingress manifest now. Snippet: ```
match:
  headers:
    X-GC-Env: "pilot"
  cidrs: ["198.51.101.55/32"]
qps:
  soft_limit: 220
  duration: 36h
  expire_at: 2026-04-21T10:00:00+08:00
logging:
  retention_days: 21
  redact_payloads: true
notes: "GroveCare pilot; manual throttle via console; renewal follow-up"
```
deploy-bot: Change staged by Li_NetOps on apac-proxy-4. Staging ID: stg-1a2b. Scheduled apply 2026-04-20T08:45:00+08:00.
Li_NetOps: Applied stg-1a2b -> live. Header+CIDR allow active, soft QPS enabled, manual throttle UI granted to tenant. Alerts: 5xx > 0.3% OR p95 token-latency > 350ms.
Priet (GroveCare): Verified routing and headers match; initial ramp shows 160 qps stable with 2xx. Thanks.
Marta_CS: Please capture cost delta and p95 at T+12h and T+24h. Ishaan, can you prepare a short renewal brief outlining options (pilot credit vs committed discount)? Document any ops recommendations.
Ishaan_SE: Will post perf snapshots and cost/1k tokens. Also include suggestions: enable prefix caching where safe, reduce sys prompt length, and consider int8 quantization for model family.
Priet (GroveCare): Can we get a temporary secure log viewer for our compliance lead for 10d? We'll need masked payloads only.
Li_NetOps: Confirmed: 21d retention with payload redaction; provisioning secure viewer with 10d expiry and RBAC.
Marta_CS: Marked in CRM GC-410 as renewal-risk; scheduling a 30-min pricing review 2 days after auto-revoke. If any spike occurs, page oncall.
Ishaan_SE: Posting T+12h snapshot: p95=230ms, error rate 0.12%, token count ~18.5M. Estimated incremental cost for 36h window: ~$1,100. Full breakdown in CRM.
Li_NetOps: Auto-revoke scheduled and will confirm when completed. Closing config loop unless issues arise.
Priet (GroveCare): All good so far. Appreciate the quick support.
Marta_CS: Thanks team, capturing this thread in account notes.
